caption: Figure 11BT.1. The real ambient jet bundle, its Hermitian complexification, original germ transport and exact closed quotient norm are followed by the actual unit warped-torus rank3/6 decomposition. All module-compact W blocks vanish at t=1, whereas fP_W has norm and distance 1 from the module compacts and the complete-domain number-operator degree-one inverse retains 1/2. A proper lambda multiplier with its whole ideal-supported domain repairs W compactness only. Proof: Section 11BT, KJ.1-KJ.8, Section 11BT.7 and KJC.1-KJC.9. No auxiliary index, general covariance or reduced scalar class is inferred.
